metadata.reproducibility_note: gym RNG and perturbation RNGs are seeded per replicate; the underlying BB84 dataset uses secrets (OS entropy), so each replicate is an independent draw. Error bars are +/-1 SD across 5 replicates.

evasion_metric: fraction of genuine attack samples (eavesdrop + partial_intercept) each defense lets through: static = induced QBER < 0.11; ML = predicted 'clean' after epsilon perturbation of attack samples
